title: Falcons DC Jeff Ulbrich: Too early to say if we have to prepare not to have James Pearce

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Falcons DC Jeff Ulbrich: Too early to say if we have to prepare not to have James Pearce
sources.description: Falcons defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich is not sure whether he needs to prepare not to have edge rusher James Pearce on his defense for some or all of the 2026 season.
